question: Consider two isotopes of Chlorine, $^{35}Cl$ and $^{37}Cl$. Describe the relationship between their nuclear densities with reason.

options.A: $^{37}Cl$ has a higher nuclear density because it has more neutrons.
options.B: $^{35}Cl$ has a higher nuclear density because it is smaller.
options.C: Both isotopes have the exact same nuclear density.
options.D: The density depends on the number of protons only.
